none: PAS KENT-1BB75A: Roman coin: Copper alloy radiate coin of Victorinus
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, Radiate or Antoninianus copper alloy coin of Victorinus. Obverse: Radiate bust right - full curly beard with hook nose. Inscription: IMP [VICTORINVS PF AVG]. Reverse: Salus holding sceptre and feeding a snake rising from an altar. Inscription: [S]ALVS AVG. No mink mark. Die axis: 6 o'clock. Very worn or fair condition. Slightly irregular, oval flan, silvery…
